title: Shipment Exception Form
subtitle: Shipment Exception: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Shipment Exception Form covers shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action. The shipment exception coordinator records Shipment Exception activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Shipment Exception Form keeps Shipment Exception exceptions visible until the shipment exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Shipment Exception Form at origin, in-transit node, destination, vehicle, and recovery location. Document shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action identity before Shipment Exception begins. Compare shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action findings with stated Shipment Exception criteria; route unresolved Shipment Exception issues to transport operations reviewer. For Shipment Exception Form, confirm requirements for Shipment Exception. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Shipment Exception conditions beyond the shipment exception coordinator's role.
